problem: The request policy rejected a cross-site top-level GET of the public app shell before local password entry. A manually typed iPhone denial is not yet attributed because a fresh phone request has not been observed.
change: Allow only GET / and /index.html, including query strings, with navigate/document metadata. Preserve TLS, private peer and exact pinned Host checks, provided-Origin validation, cross-site private API/subresource/frame denial and exact mutation Origin/CSRF/session controls.

browsers.metadata: Firefox/WebKit reported cross-site navigation metadata; Chromium metadata was explicitly modeled in the disposable TLS fixture. No physical iPhone claim.

browser_cleanup.mechanism: Exact task profiles captured from private browser launch logs; browsers closed gracefully and removed their profiles. Verified disappearance using actual user temp directory and checked task process exit. No unrelated profiles/processes were removed.

live_http.tls: Verified against existing local CA; no trust/configuration changes.

sdd.assessment: Existing implementation correction under UC-001, FR-01.1, NFR-11.3 and current architecture local request boundary. No product actors, private permissions, design, provider/model choices, storage or document authority changed; no SDD content/manifest rewrite needed.
sdd.release: No full-unit or whole-product release claim.

diagnostics: Temporary sanitized local request diagnostics remain outside the source tree while awaiting the phone reproduction. No cookies, passwords, private payloads, raw hosts or raw peer addresses are recorded.
